understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid to step onto each goal cell only when the carried piece exactly matches that goal’s required shape, color, and rotation; completing all goals in the level advances to the next level, and winning requires completing all levels before running out of lives/turns.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs 1 stamina; when stamina reaches 0 you lose 1 life and stamina resets to max, and losing all lives ends the game. Movement is constrained by walls, and the state provides blocked_directions that must never be chosen because they waste a turn and stamina without moving. Stepping on modifier tiles changes the carried piece: shape tiles cycle shapes 0–5, color tiles cycle orange→blue→green→red→orange, and rotation tiles rotate 90° clockwise through 0/90/180/270. A goal becomes activated only when shape, color, and rotation all match simultaneously, and stepping onto an activated goal completes it.
